notes: 'Starting Possibilities (7)' as posted: Obi-Wan's Hut, 'Careful Planning - Toschi Station, Jabba's Palace' and 'Signal - Goo Nee Tay, Scrambled Transmission', dested as the seven cards Obi-Wan's Hut, Careful Planning, Tatooine: Tosche Station, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, The Signal, Goo Nee Tay and Scrambled Transmission (total 60 as published). Two starting Interrupts are offered as options, so starting.interrupt is left empty. The Signal appears once in the starting group and once under Interrupts (2 in all).

'Obi' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi (Premiere); 'EPP Luke' Luke With Lightsaber; 'EPP Han' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'RPoint' Rendezvous Point; 'DFTD' Don't Forget The Droids; 'SatMess' Sorry About The Mess; 'Revo' Revolution; 'Savrip' Mantellian Savrip; 'Toschi Station' Tatooine: Tosche Station.

The post calls this 'No Shelter back a bit with a few adjustments'; the earlier No Shelter list published on Trandosite ([[Mike Fitzgerald No Shelter]]) differs, so this is filed as a separate page. The strategy text is signed 'Pavlik'.
